# robots.txt - generated by apply-robots-aeo.js

# POLICY: AI and answer-engine crawlers are ALLOWED. This site is a travel
# operator that wants to be citable in AI answers (AEO), so crawler access is
# granted deliberately. Edit AI_BOTS in apply-robots-aeo.js rather than by hand.
#
# WHY EVERY GROUP REPEATS THE RESTRICTIONS:
# robots.txt gives each user-agent its OWN group - a specific User-agent line
# replaces the wildcard group for that bot instead of merging with it. A bare
# "Allow: /" group for an AI bot would silently drop /search/ and /*?* for that
# crawler. Each group therefore carries the identical restriction set.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Internal search results are noindex; they add nothing to crawl budget.
# A Disallow is matched from the START of the path, so /search/ on its own
# covers only the English tree. The wildcard form covers the de/, fr/, es/
# and it/ copies as well, which are noindex but would otherwise still be
# crawled - defeating the crawl-budget saving the line above is there for.
Disallow: /search/
Disallow: /*/search/

# Query-string URLs carry no unique content on a static site (duplicate-content guard).
Disallow: /*?*
